# GitHub Copilot Instructions — CreatorHub

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide source of truth.

- Read the relevant `.agents/skills/` instructions before React/Next.js, UI, security, or deployment changes.
- Preserve existing working AI tools, prompt library, tools directory, and resource pages.
- Keep private AI keys server-side; never expose secrets in client bundles or logs.
- Implement clear loading, success, empty, timeout, quota, and error states for AI features.
- Do not invent capabilities, pricing, testimonials, affiliate status, or monetization claims.
- Keep UI responsive and accessible, use suitable licensed assets, and run available checks before reporting completion.
